title: BigQuery costs: from $449 to $15 a month
context: Condensed from many Codex sessions. The briefs are paraphrased; the steps, findings and numbers come from the repo's commits and docs.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Cut the BigQuery bill for the daily build. Raw data and report numbers must not change.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: Find the cost
compact.summary: Cut the BigQuery bill for the daily build. Raw data and report numbers must not change.

messages.name: BigQuery
messages.text: Read billed bytes from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT (region-eu) for a full dbt build.

compact.label: Measure
compact.title: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS
compact.summary: Billed bytes per model and per test.

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: One staging view is 70% of the bill.

compact.title: Where the money goes
compact.summary: One view, joined by 10 marts, reads 9 tables every time.
items: 5 not_null tests = the same view 5 times
Stage is a byte-for-byte copy of prod

thinking.title: What it checked
thinking.summary: Cost split by model and test, then compared with output size.
items: Compared bytes read against rows produced.
Checked who read the stage datasets over 30 days.

contentBlocks.text: The exchange-rate model is a view. Ten marts join it, and each one re-runs a union distinct over nine fact views just to find the account/date pairs.

rows.note: 3,780 reads in 30 days, all from dbt-runner

contentBlocks.title: Proposal
contentBlocks.text: 1) Make the FX model a table. 2) A dense date spine instead of the union. 3) One not_null_columns test per model. 4) Take stage off the daily path.

tooltip.title: Measure, don't guess
tooltip.body: The agent proves it with billed bytes, not intuition. 70% comes from one model.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Before changing the model, prove no account/date pair is lost and no rate changes.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: Prove it first
compact.summary: Before changing the model, prove no account/date pair is lost and no rate changes.

messages.name: dbt + BigQuery
messages.text: A/B comparison of the old union view and the new spine on identical inputs.

compact.label: Verify
compact.title: A/B and a new test
compact.summary: Old and new model on the same data.

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: The new test doesn't show a regression. It shows an old bug.

compact.title: Hidden bug
compact.summary: The ECB published nothing for 13 days, but the model only carried rates forward for 7.

contentBlocks.text: The A/B check proves nothing was lost. But the coverage test fails: the ECB feed went dark for 13 days (26 May – 7 June 2026), longer than the 7-day carry-forward window.

items: Every USD, GBP, RON and MXN account had an empty cost_eur for 2–7 June.
fx_carry_forward_days becomes 30. That's safe: rn = 1 always picks the nearest earlier rate, so a wider window fills gaps without changing a rate already found.

tooltip.title: The test that pays off
tooltip.body: The optimisation added a new test, and the test found a bug the reports had hidden for weeks.

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: One change is a trade-off and needs a human decision.

compact.title: A decision for a human
compact.summary: Stage off the daily path = −50% on the bill, but no safety stage.
items: prod_test is now the gate, after prod_build

contentBlocks.text: Stage validates code, and the daily refresh runs the same code on new data. Dropping stage saves 50%, but a bad build would overwrite prod and be caught right after, instead of being stopped.

contentBlocks.title: Question
contentBlocks.text: Do you accept this trade-off? The repo has no CI yet, so --include-stage has to be run by hand when models change.

messages.name: Brief
messages.text: Accepted. Record the trade-off and the rejected ideas in docs.

compact.label: Brief
compact.title: Decision
compact.summary: Accepted. Record the trade-off and the rejected ideas in docs.

The trade-off is a human decision.
The decision is recorded in the repo.
